candidate_visible: Only inputs/<case-id>/request.md and inputs/<case-id>/fixture/ reach a candidate, through heldout_review.build. Oracles, controls, samples, this manifest, the freeze and the reviewer record stay outside every candidate mount, prompt and response schema.

adapter_notes: Review cases load scan/SKILL.md with the ordinary report-only request; scan may dispatch reviewer subagents within the protocol delegation cap.

feedback-repair loads remedy/SKILL.md. Remedy confirms GitHub with gh repo view and fetches threads with scripts/pr-threads fetch; the offline double serves both for pull request 23, and the offline tests run the pinned pr-threads against it. Remedy pushes by default, which the request forbids; resolve calls are GraphQL mutations the double rejects as publication.
mana.resolved_from: git objects of the pinned commit; matches run.py --payload-inventory over git archive of skills/

adapter_notes: Review cases load pstack/skills/interrogate/SKILL.md, a report-only adversarial review that never applies changes. It fans out one read-only reviewer per configured model through the host task tool; with user configuration disabled its table defaults and its in-skill fallback rule apply. Reviewer fan-out shares the protocol delegation cap.

feedback-repair loads pstack/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md, which routes review comments to the Babysit playbook. Its threads-only mode answers review comments and touches nothing else; it resolves the forge with gh, which the offline double serves for pull request 23. Its fix or dismiss steps reply on threads, which the request forbids and the double rejects as publication. The watcher scripts/watch-pr/watch-pr needs bun and installs dependencies on first run, so it cannot run in the offline sandbox; threads-only mode needs thread reads, not the merge watcher, and an attempted watcher call is recorded as an unsupported operation for the protocol stop rule. The second reviewer decides whether this route is equivalent.

poteto-mode names the deslop skill from cursor-team-kit before commit. It is included at cursor-team-kit/skills/deslop/SKILL.md from the same pin. docs/harness/claude-code.md covers Cursor-only features under Claude Code and is not relied on here.
interrogate output uses Act on, Consider, Noted and Dismissed buckets. Graders normalize only Act on as actionable, the same rule applied to Mana blocking findings.
